explain.body: Cellar reads the steps and guesses which ingredients each one uses. The grid then shows each step next to those ingredients. This is a guess made by fixed rules on this server; nothing is sent to an AI service. Recipes the guess cannot handle are best kept as a list. After saving, use Edit grid layout on the recipe page to adjust which rows each step covers. Before saving, you can also change the row numbers in each step.

help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.intro: Each table is one tab stop. Press Tab to reach it, then use these keys on the focused row, step or banner. None of them apply while you type in a field.
help.walk: Arrow keys, Home, End, Ctrl+Home, Ctrl+End
help.walkDo: Move between rows, steps and banners. Page Up and Page Down jump to the previous or next section.
help.enterDo: Edit the row text, open the step panel, or open the banner panel.
help.menuDo: On a row: open Row actions (edit, move, add below, split, delete). On a step or banner: open its panel.
help.rowMoveDo: Row: move it up or down. Step: move its top edge up or down. Banner: move it within its group.
help.stepBottomDo: Step: move its bottom edge up or down.
help.stepColumnDo: Step: move it to the previous or next column.
help.delDo: Delete the row, step or banner. Undo is offered for 10 seconds.
help.undoDo: Undo and redo, when you are not typing in a field.
help.escDo: Cancel an edit, close a menu or panel, and return to where you were.
help.commitDo: While editing a row: save it and start a new row below.
help.mouse: The Move up, Move down and Row actions buttons next to each row are for mouse and touch. They are skipped by Tab so a table is one stop.
